description: Answers 'who is agent X' for an opaque agent_id. UNIQUE(agent_id) ALONE, so the spawner can register with the one identifier it holds. Two writers merge into one row: the SubagentStart hook writes IDENTITY, gm agent register writes AUTHORITY (role, methodology, phase). The join is at READ time, so ordering is not a constraint — a late registration still explains rows already written. Distinct from agent_briefing, whose per-phase key cannot hold four same-typed explorers.
name: Agent Registration

properties.description: The opaque agent identifier from the payload — NEVER parsed; its shape varies by spawn kind
properties.name: Agent Id

properties.description: The conversation the agent was spawned in — data, not a key: every spawn shape shares the primary's conversation
properties.name: Claude Session Id

properties.description: The spawning TURN (payload field: prompt_id) — Claude Code's turn id, never a gmcc prompt uuid
properties.name: Claude Turn Id

properties.description: The gmcc session resolved at registration; written by the identity half
properties.name: Session

properties.description: The prompt the agent was spawned into; spawn-time truth, since an agent belongs to one phase of one prompt
properties.name: Prompt

properties.description: Payload LABEL only, never authoritative: overloaded by spawn shape (subagent_type / workflow-subagent / teammate NAME)
properties.name: Agent Type

properties.description: The authoritative role — SPAWNER-registered; for a bare workflow agent it exists nowhere else
properties.name: Role

properties.description: The authoritative methodology — SPAWNER-registered; same-typed personas differ by agent_id alone
properties.name: Methodology

properties.description: The phase the agent was spawned into — SPAWNER-registered; completes the authority triple
properties.name: Workflow Phase
